SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE REGISTRY.
REPORT
No. D 37/4 SECTION 2 Station
Date 15 / 6 Date 34 June 15, 1932
File No. ............

Subject (in full)....Dmitry L. Makedonsky, deportee from Hongkong.

Made by......D.S.Prokofiev................Forwarded by O.I.G. [签名]

With reference to the attached cutting from the
"Shanghai Times" of June 6, 1932, entitled "In Hongkong with no
passport", enquiries show that Dmitry L. Makedonsky, a Jugo-Slavi-
an, who was arrested by the Hongkong police on May 28, 1932 for
being in the Colony without a passport, was later deported from
Hongkong to Shanghai and arrived in this city on or about June
12 on board a Chinese vessel.

He is personally known to Dr.Y.P.Ryabin, a local
medical practitioner who has his office at No 14 Kiukiang Road
and who claims to be a representative of the local Jugo-Slavian
community. Dr.Ryabin informed the undersigned that Makedonsky's
statement regarding Jugo-Slavien subjects being repatriated
from Shanghai was correct, as arrangements are being made where-
by the Government of Jugo-Slavia will grant free passage Home to
40 families ( about 120 persons ) of indigent Jugo-Slavian sub-
jects residing in China and wishing to be repatriated.

On May 6, 1932 a notification to this effect was
published by Dr.Ryabin in local Russian newspapers ( a transla-
tion is attached ), and he is in receipt of letter dated May 12,
1932, Canton, from Makedonsky, in which the latter requests to be
put on the list of those desiring to be repatriated. This re-
quest was complied with.

Makedonsky, prior to his departure for Canton towards
the end of 1931, resided in Shanghai for several years. There is
nothing in Municipal Police records to his detriment.

Enquiries have been made at the Passport Examina-
tion Office of the Shanghai Public Safety Bureau, No 38 Avenue Ed-
ward VII, with a view to ascertaining approximate number of per-
sons deported to Shanghai from Hongkong and other colonies and

日期 1932年6月15日
档案号 ____

主题（全称）____ 德米特里·L·马肯东斯基（Dmitry L. Makedonsky），自香港被驱逐者。

制作人 ____ D.S.普罗科菲耶夫（D.S.Prokofiev） ____ 转呈人 O.I.G. [签名]

关于附上的1932年6月6日《字林西报》（Shanghai Times）剪报，标题为“无护照在香港”，经查询显示，德米特里·L·马肯东斯基，一名南斯拉夫人，于1932年5月28日因无护照身处该殖民地而被香港警方逮捕，随后从香港被驱逐至上海，并于6月12日左右乘坐一艘中国船只抵达本市。

本地执业医师Y.P.里亚宾博士（Dr.Y.P.Ryabin） personally 认识他，其诊所位于九江路14号，并自称是本地南斯拉夫社群的代表。里亚宾博士告知签署人，马肯东斯基关于南斯拉夫臣民从上海被遣返的说法是正确的，因为目前正在安排由南斯拉夫政府为居住在中国并希望被遣返的贫困南斯拉夫臣民40个家庭（约120人）提供免费回国船票。

1932年5月6日，里亚宾博士在本地俄文报纸上发布了此类通知（附译文），并收到马肯东斯基于1932年5月12日从广州寄来的信件，信中请求将其列入希望被遣返者名单。该请求已获准。

在1931年底前往广州之前，马肯东斯基在上海居住了数年。工部局警务处档案中没有任何对其不利的记录。

39/3
THE SHANGHAI TIMES, MONDAY, JUNE 6, 1932

IN HONGKONG WITH
NO PASSPORT

Jugo-Slavian Who Came
From Canton; Man
Sent To Prison

Dmitri Lazebovich Makedonsky,
a Jugo-Slavian, appeared before
Mr. Wynne-Jones at the Central
Magistracy in Hongkong charged
with being in the Colony without
a passport.
Det. Sergt. Mottram, prosecuting, stated that in November last
year H.B.M. Consul in Canton
wrote to the Inspector-General of
Police here saying that* Makedonsky had applied for a visa for
Hongkong and asking if the I.G.P.
could recommend it. The reply
by the I.G.P. was to the effect that
such a visa could not be recommended, but in spite of the refusal,
Makedonsky was some time afterwards found staying at a boarding-house in Kowloon. He was
warned and deported back to Canton.

Making For Shanghai
He turned up again on Friday,
and in giving himself up told the
police that he was en route to
Shanghai where he learned Jugo-
Slavians were being repatriated,
and that his desire was to go with
them. The police had no such
information. The prisoner had no
visa for Hongkong, simply an
endorsement on the back of the
document "Visa applied for." The
Japanese ship on which the
prisoner was hoping to go to
Shanghai was stated to be sailing
on the 6th of next month. How he
could get there on the five dollars
which were all he had, he (Sergt.
Mottram) could not see.
The officer asked that a fairly
lenient sentence, say of seven
days' hard labour, be imposed,
which would carry them on to the
6th when they would see if there
were any means of deporting the
man to Shanghai. In the opinion
of the officer that would be better
than a longer sentence entailing
the man again being returned to
Canton.
The Magistrate agreed, and
sentenced Makedonsky to seven
days' hard labour.

（批：For information）
（签名）

39/3
《字林西报》，1932年6月6日，星期一

无护照在香港

来自广州的南斯拉夫人；
男子被判入狱

德米特里·拉泽博维奇·马肯东斯基（Dmitri Lazebovich Makedonsky），
一名南斯拉夫人，在香港中央裁判司署
出庭，受韦恩-琼斯先生（Mr. Wynne-Jones）审理，
被控无护照身处该殖民地。
检控官莫特拉姆警佐（Det. Sergt. Mottram）陈述，去年11月，
英国驻广州领事致函
本港警察总监，称* 马肯东斯基
已申请香港签证，并询问
警察总监能否予以推荐。
警察总监的回复大意是
不能推荐此类签证，但尽管
遭到拒绝，马肯东斯基还是在
一段时间后被发现住在九龙的一家寄宿公寓。他受到
警告并被驱逐回广州。

前往上海
他于周五再次出现，并在自首时告诉
警方，他正在前往上海的途中，他得知
南斯拉夫人正在被遣返，
他的愿望是随他们一同前往。警方并无
此类信息。该囚犯没有香港
签证，仅在文件背面有“已申请
签证”的签注。据说该囚犯
希望乘坐前往上海的日本轮船
将于下月6日启航。他仅有
五美元，不知如何能到达那里，
他（莫特拉姆警佐）表示无法理解。
该警官请求判处相对
较轻的刑罚，例如七天苦役，
这样刑期将持续到6日，届时
他们将看看是否有办法将该
男子驱逐至上海。在该警官
看来，这比判处较长刑期导致
该男子再次被送回广州要好。
裁判司同意，并判处
马肯东斯基七天苦役。

（批注：供参考）
（签名）

档案。

签证，仅在文件背面有“已申请
签证”的签注。据说该囚犯
希望乘坐前往上海的日本轮船
将于下月6日启航。他仅有
五美元，不知如何能到达那里，
他（莫特拉姆侦探）表示无法理解。
该警官请求判处相对
较轻的刑罚，例如七天
苦役，这样刑期将持续到
6日，届时他们将看看是否有
办法将其驱逐至上海。在该
警官看来，这比判处较长
刑期导致该男子再次被送回
广州要好。
